summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting two items: (1) the termination of a material definitive agreement — its subsidiary Semler Scientific repurchased and cancelled all outstanding 4.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030, satisfying and discharging the related indenture, releasing Semler from remaining obligations; and (2) an amendment to its Articles of Incorporation amending the Certificate of Designation for its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock (SATA Stock) to modify dividend calculation periods. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review is present; the filing reflects routine debt extinguishment and a charter amendment. What to watch: none; the filing is administrative in nature.
